blocks.text: Insaan ki zyada tar bimariyan microbes (jaraseem) ke infections se hoti hain, yaani viruses, bimari phelane wale (pathogenic) bacteria, fungi ya protists ka jism mein ghus aana. Infections aur cancers se bachne ke liye vertebrates (reerh ki haddi wale janwaron) mein aik difa (defence) ka system hota hai jise immune system kehte hain. Yeh musalsal khoon ki jaanch karta rehta hai ke kahin koi bairooni (foreign) cells ya molecules to maujood nahin. Maslan jab immune system kisi infection ko pakarta hai to hamla karne wale microbes par hamla kar ke unhein tabah kar deta hai. Isi liye woh bimariyan jo immune system ko kamzor karti hain, jaise AIDS, bohat khatarnak hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Hamare jism ka infection se bachao bilkul aise hota hai jaise kisi shehar ko bahar ke hamle se bachaya jata hai. Deewarein hamla awaron ka andar aana mushkil banati hain, gasht karti police ajnabiyon ko check karti hai, aur security guard har ghoomne wale ko rokte hain aur sahi shanakhti card (ID) na ho to police bula lete hain. Hamare jism mein bhi difa ki mukhtalif lines hain.

blocks.alt: Upar se neeche flowchart. Invasive microbe, phir difa ki pehli line, ghair makhsoos: jild, hazme ki nali, saans ki nali. Agar pehli line toot jaye to jism doosri line se jawab deta hai, ghair makhsoos: khoon ke killer cells, antimicrobial proteins, sozish, bukhar. Agar doosri line toot jaye to teesri line, makhsoos (specific): cell-mediated immunity aur antibody-mediated immunity.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.1: Infection ke khilaf difa ki lines (kitab ki Figure 21.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehli aur doosri line non-specific (ghair makhsoos) hain: yeh har hamla awar ke khilaf aik hi tarah kaam karti hain. Agar pehli line toot jaye to doosri line kaam karti hai, aur agar doosri bhi toot jaye to teesri line, jo specific (makhsoos) hai: cell-mediated aur antibody-mediated immunity.
Infections ke khilaf difa ki pehli line skin (jild), digestive tract (hazme ki nali) aur respiratory tract (saans ki nali) par mushtamil hai.

blocks.prompt: Difa ki pehli line kin cheezon par mushtamil hai?
blocks.explanation: Skin (jild), digestive tract aur respiratory tract.

items: Immune system infections aur cancers se bachata hai aur khoon mein bairooni cells aur molecules ki jaanch karta hai.
Teen lines: pehli aur doosri non-specific, teesri specific.
Pehli line: skin, digestive tract, respiratory tract.
